title: Register your stall
intro: After you register, an admin reviews the stall. You can sign in right away and set up your profile, but products go live only after approval.

fields.stallHint: Customers see this name on the map and on orders.

banner.title: MarketLink does not check licences or organic certification.
banner.text: Approval confirms the stall exists and the contact details work. Say what you grow and how at the stall itself.
